description: Source code for a realtime timing worker class managing synchronization and symbol notifications in a radio communication system.

classes.name: realtime_timing_worker
classes.description: Class managing real-time timing, synchronization, and symbol notification in a radio system.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::realtime_timing_worker
methods.description: Constructor initializing timing worker with configuration, setting system time validation, and GPS offset.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::start
methods.description: Starts the timing worker, initializes timing loop, and synchronizes start.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::stop
methods.description: Stops the timing worker and clears notifiers.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::timing_loop
methods.description: Main loop polling for timing events until stop requested.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::poll
methods.description: Performs timing calculations, detects clock jumps, and notifies symbols.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::notify_slot_symbol_point
methods.description: Notifies all registered notifiers of a new symbol point.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes notifiers for symbol boundary events.
